record.reason: The primary abstract introduces a two-dimensional relative self-attention mechanism to augment convolutional networks for discriminative visual tasks, reporting image-classification and object-detection results while keeping parameter counts similar. It is an image-vision architecture contribution, not an LLM inference/serving system or an inference-time efficiency/compression method for LLMs. The mere use of self-attention is insufficient for scope inclusion.
record.title: Attention Augmented Convolutional Networks
